steps.note: THE BOARD SAYS GOODBYE. Somebody switched WEB CONSOLE off on the device -- so the console is not gone, it took its screen back, and it says so for a few seconds before closing (moy_webhost.stop's window; the twin does the same via --close-after). What this must prove is that the page reads that as EXPECTED: no alarm, no data-loss warning, and a sentence that says what to do. Before this, every deliberate shutdown reached a reader as the vanished-board panel.

Nothing is touched. The idle heartbeat is what finds the goodbye, which is also the case the reader was in. The wait is long because the twin's --close-after counts from when IT started, which is before the browser has even booted -- so the window has to open between the two probes, not before the first.
